cn2.text: Daretti's own cogwork construct exploded, apparently killing him, but the blast ignited his spark and he planeswalked away, losing the use of his legs.
After Marchesa was crowned, Daretti allied with disenfranchised goblins under Grenzo to take revenge, and his schemes led to the Academy's disbanding.
Daretti and Grenzo raided Professor Fimarell's home, where Daretti discovered the plagiarism of his words and heaved Fimarell through the window.
Daretti then named Alendis as his next target while the villa burned.

dft.text: Daretti had lost his spark in the Desparkening and was stranded on Avishkar, so he bankrolled the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, hoping to find new interplanar travel.
The Rocketeers used Daretti as a decoy and he was taken to a saurid village and imprisoned with Loot to be sacrificed, until Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescued them.
The four escaped through an Omenpath to Amonkhet and crash-landed, and Daretti, Pia and Chandra built an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.
Back at Ghirapur, Daretti backed Chandra as she fought insurgents in Mohar Varma's attempted Consulate coup, which was prevented.
